description: Réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in Ville de Tourcoing open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Tourcoing. Coverage: Tourcoing. The portal files it under Transport, Mobility. Its keywords are cyclable, piste. The portal shows 407 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-tourcoing-fr-portal.
